name: Museum Specimen Labels
summary: Every caught anomaly becomes a curated museum exhibit: a pinned specimen under glass with a crisp wall label.
look: A calm, spotlit gallery wall in pale teal-grey with salon-hung framed dashboards, a glass vitrine on a plinth, and white wall labels set in italic serif titles, mono catalogue codes and short sans context. A single coral pin marks the moment of the drop.

components.name: Specimen
components.role: the anomalous chart fragment presented under glass

components.name: Wall label
components.role: catalogue number, italic title, meta line, three lines of context and the action buttons

components.name: Catalogue code
components.role: mono IDs like PL-2231 tying the exhibit to the deploy

components.name: Coral pin
components.role: one coral pin with a real shadow marking the drop

components.name: Vitrine & plinth
components.role: thin glass case with reflection gradient on a pale plinth

components.name: Wall vinyl & wayfinding
components.role: serif headlines on the wall and mono gallery signs

motion.name: Rail slide
motion.how: labels enter sideways 40 px, power3.out 500 ms, landing on a downbeat at 120 BPM

motion.name: Spotlight
motion.how: radial light brightens the specimen over 800 ms sine.inOut from beat 1 of each exhibit

motion.name: Wall pan
motion.how: slow dolly between exhibits, one exhibit per bar (2 s), power1.inOut

story: Hook: a salon wall of framed dashboards with the vinyl 'How many dashboards did you check today?' and a label 'Untitled (38 Dashboards), 2026 — opened daily, read rarely. Checked: 3.' Reveal: the spotlight snaps on for the drop over dimensional 'Acme Pulse' lettering with the mark: 'A permanent exhibition of every metric, every minute.' Proof: Exhibit 1 — the checkout chart under glass with a coral pin on the drop; label 'No. PL-2231 · Checkout conversion, −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231 · Discovered by Acme Pulse, decided by the on-call team' with Roll back / Acknowledge. CTA: the exit wall 'Caught before customers noticed.' and an admission desk card with the lockup and Start free.
adapt: Treat each thing your product catches or creates (a bug, a lead, a saved hour) as an exhibit: a screenshot as the specimen, your own data in the label's three lines.

fit.risk: gallery pace can feel slow; every move must still land on the beat
